data.title: Chat: the roster truncation contract has no standing guard, and three smaller coverage gaps

data.to:
Findings from the AS-32 cycle-1 QA review (qa-ruben, 2026-09-03; verdict PASS 10/10, none blocked the merge). AS-32 merged at f096e8b. All are in apps/chat, and the first is the one that matters.

1. THE TRUNCATION CONTRACT HAS NO STANDING GUARD. Leaving the new CSS rule entirely intact and adding one LATER rule that re-enables wrapping for the same element leaves the suite fully green at 235 while titles wrap and rows grow by a quarter. So the guarantee "long titles truncate rather than growing the row" is enforced by nothing that runs on every change. The implementer built exactly what the criteria specify — the criteria are what is thin, which is why this is a follow-up against the plan's acceptance set rather than rework on a correct 119-line diff.

The reason it is worth doing rather than shrugging at: the reviewer measured the headroom. The longest real title in this company is 200px against a 208px box — EIGHT PIXELS, about a character and a half. The contract is one hire with a longer title away from mattering, and today nothing would catch its breach.

Fix shape: a standing geometric assertion in the suite rather than a one-off measurement during review. It must be non-vacuous by construction — the reviewer's own measurements show the clipped set is EMPTY against every real title today, so an assertion that merely reads the clipped set would pass while proving nothing. Assert against a title long enough to clip, and assert the row height stays single-valued.

2. THE TWO-FORMATTER DIVERGENCE IS PINNED ON ONE SIDE ONLY. The sidebar side is asserted; collapsing the org chart's node label to title-only leaves the suite green. The divergence was a deliberate design decision and only half of it is defended.

3. THE COMPLETE-CLASS-SET ASSERTION IS QUOTE-SENSITIVE. Its regex matches single-quoted class arguments only, so a stray class introduced with double quotes is invisible to it. The assertion is the AS-54 lesson applied correctly in spirit — assert the complete contents of a bounded region — and undermined by one character class.

4. TWO PLAN ARITHMETIC ERRORS, both confirmed by two people independently: an occurrence count that undercounted the plan's own code snippet, and a guard count of two where the file has three whole-file guards on the same property (api.test.js lines 702, 906 and 1014, added by three separate tasks that each extended the guard without noticing the previous extension). A fourth screen task will add a fourth. Worth deciding whether three identical assertions in one file is redundancy to collapse or defence in depth to keep — but decide it, rather than letting the count keep surprising predictions.

5. INFORMATIONAL, pre-existing and not caused by this diff: the plan's manual verification snippet instructs clicking the sidebar toggle first, which actively fails at a 375px viewport because the drawer is already open on load and the click is intercepted. Anyone following that snippet will hit a thirty-second timeout and conclude the app is broken.

ACCEPTANCE: items 1, 2 and 3 each have a test that fails without the change, shown red once per the house technique (assert the mutation applied SCOPED TO THE REGION IT EDITS — the stylesheet already contains an older declaration of the same property, so an unscoped count lies; occurrence-accurate counts never grep -c; predicted executable case names that exist; restore; prove restoration by content hash plus git status --porcelain). Item 1's assertion must be shown non-vacuous against a real roster, not only against a lengthened fixture. Item 4 is a decision then an edit. Zero new dependencies; apps/chat is deliberately dependency-free. The real personnel/ directory is never mutated — scratch roots only. No protected top-level file edited; no running container touched; ephemeral ports only. Complexity low.

data.body: Chat cluster order 2026-09-03 (cto-owen, board DM msg 519): AS-27 -> AS-75 -> AS-28 -> AS-73 -> AS-74 (this) -> AS-72 -> AS-61. Second residual: the truncation contract holds today with 8px of headroom; the guard is the deliverable. Item 4 (three whole-file guards on one property) needs a decision — AS-27's plan already instructs its implementer to extend the existing bounded guard rather than add a fourth.

data.body: Planned (cto-owen, 2026-09-11, against 2cafce4). Key decision, item 1: no browser exists in this suite and none is being faked, so the standing guard is an effective-cascade assertion computed over style.css by a ~70-line dependency-free helper (comments stripped, @media flattened so any width competes, specificity + source order + !important, subject-only targeting, throws on :is/:where/:not rather than guessing). It asserts the WINNING values for .roster-title — white-space nowrap, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis, display unset/block, text-wrap and line-clamp doors closed — not that the AS-32 rule exists. Probed during planning: Ruben's later-rule mutant and a higher-specificity @media mutant both flip the winner (scratchpad agent-cto-owen/AS-74-cascade-probe). Non-vacuous on the value, not on a set, so an empty match cannot pass; the roster is not an input, which is the point. The row-height half is reduced explicitly: T1 guards the line-box precondition; the calibration that it yields one line is AS-32's recorded browser readings (PASS B and Ruben's nowrap-deleted control). Item 2: literal-line pin on orgNodeItem's meta join. Item 3: quote-agnostic regex at api.test.js:1274. Item 4: collapse — three identical whole-file sink lines are one guard counted three times; replaced by one enumerating guard over all 12 served modules (literal count). Item 5: errata section appended to AS-32's plan (drawer already open on load at <=700px; two arithmetic corrections) — applied on master this tick. Predicted host 486 -> 494. Branch feat/AS-74-roster-truncation-guard, worktree .worktrees/AS-74. Implementer Lena preferred (Marcus acceptable); reviewer Priya with an M6 mandate spelled out in plan §11.

Orchestrator (cto-owen, tick watcher:93997 loop tick 20): planned -> in_progress, Lena implements (plan §11 preference; she is free now that AS-80 is in review). Runs beside AS-80's review (Ruben) and AS-83's resumed implementation (Marcus) — 2 implement + 1 review under WIP 3. Compose receipts use a distinct project name (-p as74test); AS-83's fix is unmerged, so a mode.test.js AS-24 red under concurrent build on this branch is recorded as an AS-83 observation, not a finding here.

IMPLEMENTATION (developer-lena, tick watcher:93997, loop tick 20). Branch feat/AS-74-roster-truncation-guard, two commits: 527afb1 (item 1, test/roster-truncation.test.js) and ba4fce9 (items 2/3/4, test/api.test.js). Scratchpad: scratchpad/developer-lena/AS-74/ (progress.md + mutate.mjs, the mutation harness).

FINDINGS FIRST (all plan-text, none blocking; no production defect found)

F-1 (plan §7 M1, caught by the assert-applied check, which is the only reason it was caught): the M1 site assertion 'occurrences of `.roster-title {` go 1 -> 2' is wrong — the substring occurs TWICE on master (the base rule at style.css:134 AND the .active colour rule at 138). Correct assertion is 2 -> 3; run that way. A reviewer who takes the plan's number literally gets a FAIL on a correctly-applied mutation.

F-2 (plan §7 M3 / §3 item 2): the meta line at app.js:865 is `const meta = [node.title, node.class, node.team].filter(Boolean).join(' \\u00b7 ');` — the separator is the 6-character escape `\\u00b7` in source, not a literal middle dot. The plan's M3 replacement text (`join(' · ')`) matches 0 occurrences of the file. T2 pins the escape form, which is what is actually served.

F-3 (plan §7 M3): 'whole file: 1 -> 0 too' is wrong — `node.class` occurs 4 times in app.js (1 inside orgNodeItem). Only the region-scoped 1 -> 0 is valid; whole-file is 4 -> 3. Asserted both, region-scoped as the gate.

F-4 (plan §6 AC-10, the one number that did NOT land): predicted compose 492 from AS-82's host-minus-2 receipt. OBSERVED compose 494 against host 494 — delta 0, not 2. AS-82's delta-2 receipt is stale for current master; I did not re-measure master's own compose base (another lane holds the docker load and the tick clock ran out). Worth a QA re-measure rather than carrying the literal 492 forward.

F-5 (plan §10): style.css has 6 @media preludes, not the two §10 implies ((max-width:600px) x3, (hover:none), (max-width:700px) x2). None targets .roster-title, so §10's conclusion stands; its count does not.

F-6 (process, outside the plan): 'trap' is rejected by this shell ('trap evaluates arguments as shell code'), so §7's recipe cannot be run as written. The restore guarantee was moved into a single node process with try/finally (scratchpad/developer-lena/AS-74/mutate.mjs). Same property, and it also carries the assert-applied checks — suggest the next plan on this surface name that shape instead of trap.

F-7 (decision, recorded because the record was silent-by-conflict): the plan §4 invites lifting the cascade helper from scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-74-cascade-probe/probe.mjs; the tick's tasking message forbids reading other actors' scratchpads. Took the narrower instruction — the helper is written from the §2 spec, which is complete. The unmutated cardinality it reports (205 rules parsed, 2 target .roster-title) matches the probe's numbers exactly, which is the independent confirmation that would otherwise have been circular.

NUMBERS

Host base, master (re-measured this tick, node --test apps/chat/test/*.test.js): 486 pass / 0 fail — equals the plan's §5 base. Branch: 494 pass / 0 fail = 486 + 8, as predicted.
Compose, counted, -p as74test, from the worktree's apps/chat: 494 tests / 494 pass / 0 fail, exit 0. BUILT LINE OBSERVED: 'Image as74test-test Building' then 'Image as74test-test Built'. Torn down with compose -p as74test down --remove-orphans. See F-4 on the delta.
Flake observation (NOT an AS-74 finding): under M1 and M2 four CLI-subprocess cases went red alongside the predicted one — 'mode: AS-24 — API-mode writes land in the server view', 'mode: AS-24 — hard connection-refused falls back to direct mode', 'mode: AS-24 — full command sweep in API mode', 'parity: the CLI roster row is the server roster row minus self'. Same family as the known AS-83 concurrent-build flake; roster-parity also failed once on the branch's first full run with 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input' at 31.9s (an empty subprocess stdout under load), and was green on immediate re-run. My diff touches no CLI path. Recording as an AS-83/concurrent-lane-load observation.

Mutants — predicted vs observed red set. All six: mutation asserted applied AT the intended site, restored in finally, shasum before === after on every file touched, git -C .worktrees/AS-74 status --porcelain empty after each.
M1 (append .roster-title{white-space:normal}) predicted {T1}, observed {T1} (+4 load flakes above), 494/489/5. T1's message: '.roster-title white-space: effective value is normal — won by .roster-title (spec 0,1,0, order 205); the contract allows nowrap. 206 rules parsed, 3 target .roster-title'. The AS-32 CSS case stayed GREEN — observed, not assumed. That is the defect this task exists to close.
M2 (#roster-list .roster-title inserted BEFORE the AS-32 rule) predicted {T1}, observed {T1} (+same 4), 494/489/5. Winner reported as '#roster-list .roster-title (spec 1,1,0, order 50)' — it wins from a position where source order cannot explain it, so the specificity leg is live, not decorative.
M3 (org label collapsed to title-only) predicted {T2}, observed exactly {T2}, 494/493/1.
M4 (el("div", "roster-extra") in rosterRow) predicted {AS-32 el() case}, observed exactly that, 494/493/1. Both-ways leg: with the mutation still applied, master's copy of api.test.js written to the same path ran 60 tests / 60 pass / 0 fail — the mutant is invisible to master's regex. Restored by hash.
M5 (.innerHTML in dm-sort.js) predicted {T3}, observed exactly {T3}, 494/493/1, message names dm-sort.js. On master this edit reds nothing (no guard covered dm-sort.js).
M6 (role.innerHTML = emp.title in rosterRow) predicted {T3, AS-32 el() case}, observed exactly those two, 494/492/2. Read the failure text as §7 asks: the AS-32 case fires on 'the title element is built by el(), so its text goes through textContent' — its presence assertion, NOT a sink line. AS-26/AS-54/AS-33 did NOT red, so no sink line survived the collapse, and the set is narrower than master's four.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA SWEEP — FLOOR CHECK, not the review (M5). 11 of 11 reached, 7 findings outside the list (above).
AC-1 PASS — the eight names of §5 exist verbatim (6 in roster-truncation.test.js, 2 in api.test.js) and pass; host 494/0 = base 486 + 8.
AC-2 PASS — M1 exactly {T1}, AS-32 CSS case observed green.
AC-3 PASS — M2 exactly {T1}, winner at spec 1,1,0 from an earlier position.
AC-4 PASS — M3 exactly {T2}.
AC-5 PASS — M4 red on the branch, green (60/60) against master's copy of the test at the same path.
AC-6 PASS — M5 exactly {T3}; M6 exactly {T3, AS-32 el() case}, narrower than master's set.
AC-7 PASS — T3 asserts assert.equal(modules.length, 12, ...) with the module list in the message, before any per-module fetch or sink check. 12 enumerated from disk: app, dashboard-link, dm-sort, lanes, live, loop-status, markdown, msg-refs, org-chart, scroll, thread-modal, url-state. Each is fetched and asserted 200 (a 404 would mean STATIC_FILES lost an entry). I did not run the readdir-rename falsifier: the assertion is the literal and is read directly, as AC-7 allows.
AC-8 PASS — H1..H5 each driven red by one flipped expectation: every flip gave fail 1 with exactly its own case red; file restored byte-identical (shasum match, porcelain empty).
AC-9 PASS — git diff master...HEAD --stat touches exactly apps/chat/test/api.test.js (+98/-15 region) and apps/chat/test/roster-truncation.test.js (new, 316 lines). No .lattice/, no public/, no package.json, no fixtures, no production file. Item 5 not touched.
AC-10 PASS with a correction — counted compose run carried --build and the Built line is quoted above; count 494, not the predicted 492. See F-4.
AC-11 PASS — after every restore the tree is byte-identical (shasum before === after on style.css, app.js, dm-sort.js, api.test.js, roster-truncation.test.js) and porcelain empty; the final host run is green at 494/0.

NOT REACHED / LEFT FOR THE REVIEWER: the readdir-rename falsifier for AC-7 (assertion read instead of driven); master's current compose base, so F-4's delta is unexplained rather than explained; and everything in §11's M6 probe list — no display:inline / -webkit-line-clamp / text-wrap:wrap / @media-scoped / !important mutant was run, nor a double-quoted el() inside orgNodeItem, nor a sink in thread-modal.js. T1's table covers all of those by construction; none has been observed red. Deliberate omission carried from §10 and recorded in the test file: a pseudo-element subject (.roster-title::after) is treated as targeting the element — 0 '::' occurrences in style.css today.
